relationships.subject: JAK inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: JAK inhibitors occupy the ATP-binding domain of JAK isoforms, including TYK2, thereby blocking STAT trans-phosphorylation

relationships.subject: JAK2
relationships.evidence_quote: JAK2 inhibition by pan-JAK inhibitors frequently results in dose-dependent anaemia, highlighting the link between JAK2 signalling and erythropoiesis

key_findings: Review: JAK inhibitors (tofacitinib, upadacitinib, baricitinib) show favourable outcomes in refractory palmoplantar pustulosis, mainly in case reports.
JAK inhibition blocks multiple cytokine pathways via STAT phosphorylation, but JAK2 inhibition risks anaemia.
